item.title: Texas seventh-grader Arya Hirsave helps algae produce 77% more oil in five days
item.summary: In an inspiring endeavor, seventh-grader Arya Hirsave embarked on a project focused on utilising algae to create renewable fuel. Through a five-day experiment involving a unique blend of vitamins and salt, she achieved an impressive seventy-seven percent increase in lipid production from the algae. Her remarkable findings captured the attention of judges at a distinguished science competition, showcasing the potential of youthful innovation in sustainable energy.
